name: How long does a typical deck renovation project take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical deck renovation project take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a deck renovation project with AKN Design Group varies based on the scope, design complexity, and material availability. A typical project, especially one integrated into a larger outdoor living space, might take several weeks to a few months from design finalization to completion. We prioritize clear communication, providing upfront estimates and transparent scheduling throughout the managed process. Unforeseen weather conditions or material lead times can affect timing, but we keep you informed every step of the way.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deck renovation duration varies by scope and complexity; integrated projects typically take several weeks to a few months, with transparent scheduling and communication throughout.
